subject: general
question: Which one of the following districts in Western India recorded a temperature of 1.1 degrees Celcius on December 18, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Churu'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Churu, a district in **Rajasthan, **is known for its abrupt temperatures over the years.
 
• It is located close to the **Thar desert**, one of the hottest regions of India.
 
• It recorded** 1.1 degrees Celcius on Saturday, December 18, 2021.**
 
• The Lowest temperature recorded in Churu is **-2.5 degrees Celcius.**
